title: Pine
text: Pine symbolizes longevity, endurance, moral integrity, and resilience. It is frequently paired with rocks, cranes, or scholars.

title: Plum Blossom
text: Plum blossom symbolizes perseverance and renewal because it blooms in winter and early spring.

title: Bamboo
text: Bamboo symbolizes integrity, humility, flexibility, and the cultivated scholar.

title: Solitary Boat
text: A solitary boat may express seclusion, travel, contemplation, or human smallness within the natural world.

title: Crane
text: The crane is associated with longevity, transcendence, purity, and the immortal realm.
